These static fonts are bundled only for offline PDF generation. The browser UI
continues to use system fonts; no runtime font download occurs.

- Noto Sans Regular and Bold: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/tree/main/hinted/ttf/NotoSans
- Noto Sans Symbols 2 Regular: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/tree/main/hinted/ttf/NotoSansSymbols2
- Noto Emoji: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notoemoji

Downloaded November 14, 2026. License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, included in OFL.txt.
The Noto Emoji license is included separately in NotoEmoji-OFL.txt.
Font coverage varies by script; the HTML report preview uses browser system fonts.
